controller_diagnostic.scope: Fixed training-only Cholesky coordinates around the native CEM. Model/objective and executed normalized commands both receive x=L y; original diagonal elite moments remain in white y. Original loss, weights, action history, scaler, goal metric,300x30 budget,5-step horizon and unbounded commands remain. Native original/L=I bypasses all mapping. Historical Cube outcomes are not bitwise reproducible; any replay differences are retained, not relabelled or selectively replaced. Controller diagnostic, not a new learning algorithm.
